svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 1,805 mm of 70 x 35 mm treated timber; square the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay it flat (70 mm wide, 35 mm thick). It runs across the stand,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front and back, under the ends of the side rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crossing bolts: two 8.5 mm holes at each end: 50.5 mm from the end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the centre line, and 74.5 mm from the end, 20 mm toward the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside of the stand. Drill with the side rail clamped in place.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Castor holes: four 8.5 mm holes at each end on a 42 mm square,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 112.5 mm in from the end and on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal every cut end and hole with end-grain sealer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: a side rail sits across each end; a castor bolts underneath.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the two rails are the same length within 2 mm.
